decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the development would not result in harm to the appearance of the property or the wider area, not cause harm to neighbours' living or working conditions, and would provide satisfactory access and servicing.  This is in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies IMP.2.1A (Regeneration and Enhancement of Town Centres), IMP.2.2 (Regeneration of Hounslow Town Centre), IMP.5.1 (High Quality Building and Urban Design), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), ENV -B.1.9 (Safety and Security), S.1.1 (Main Shopping Areas), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities), S.4.5 (Servicing Arrangements), S.4.6 (Customer Facilities), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments), and Supplementary Guidance 'Think Access'.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Details of the arrangements for storing of refuse and waste material shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved details shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the retail units as shown on the submitted drawings and so retained permanently.
Condition : 6 - The service area at the rear of the site, as shown on submitted drawing number 2078 P 02A, shall only be used by vehicles with a maximum length of 10 metres.
description: Demolition of storage building to rear of premises and the erection of a ground, first, and second floor extension to rear of the premises.
